name: @redvars/log
description: A small, extensible logging package built on the OpenTelemetry Logs SDK

scripts.pretest: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.coverage: npm run clean && npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage',{recursive:true})" && node --enable-source-maps --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="dist/test/**" --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info "dist/test/**/*.test.js"
